sources.articleTitle: Bus rams into 32 vehicles in Bundang, with 48 injured
57 injured as bus crashes into 31 vehicles in South Korea

headline: Mass Vehicle Collision Involving Bus Reported In Bundang Area
seoTitle: Bus Collision Causes Multiple Injuries in Bundang
metaDescription: A passenger bus struck dozens of vehicles in Bundang, South Korea, resulting in over 45 injuries as emergency services respond to the large collision.
aiSummaryBullets: A bus crashed into dozens of vehicles in the Bundang district of Seongnam.
Initial reports on the number of vehicles struck range between 31 and 32.
Emergency response teams reported between 48 and 57 individuals sustained injuries.
aiContextParagraph: On November 11, 2026, a significant traffic accident occurred in Bundang, Seongnam, South Korea, when a bus collided with a large number of vehicles on a public roadway. Local emergency services and media outlets are currently managing the aftermath of the crash, which impacted more than 30 vehicles in total. Official accounts concerning the precise scale of the incident vary slightly, with reports noting between 31 and 32 vehicles involved. Similarly, the number of casualties is currently subject to assessment, with counts of injured individuals ranging from 48 to 57 people. Authorities have commenced an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the collision, while medical teams continue to provide assistance to those affected by the incident. The scale of the accident has prompted widespread coverage across national and international news agencies as responders work to clear the site and determine the cause of the bus driver's loss of control.
whyItIsViral: The event has garnered significant media attention due to the high number of vehicles involved and the substantial volume of individuals injured in a single traffic incident.
